title: A ready-to-use AI assistant
problem: I want an AI assistant that knows my work and helps me every day.

steps.why: Download the Rowboat desktop app for Mac, Windows or Linux. It has email, notes, meeting notes and background agents. Intel Mac support: unknown.
Pick a model. Use your own key, or a local model through Ollama or LM Studio.
Add tools. Rowboat takes any MCP server in Settings and has one-click integrations.

steps.detail: Type: markdown notes with backlinks, no vector database. Level: text now, images later. Rowboat itself builds its graph from markdown links, not a graph database.
steps.why: Keep the notes as plain markdown. This pick ingests URLs, PDFs, audio and screenshots by prompt.

alternatives.why: A real multimodal retrieval engine. Heavier. Local model support: unknown.
Teaches agentic RAG. Text only. Needs an OpenAI key.

steps.detail: Pick: unknown. No report names a desktop manager. Rowboat's desktop app is the nearest part named. The captain defines this slot.
Use Rowboat only as the viewer and capture UI, not as the brain.
steps.why: A ready viewer and capture UI for the notes.

alternatives.why: Free for all purposes per its terms. Open source: unknown.

steps.detail: The software-factory idea: one dispatcher, many agents.
steps.why: One first mate sends crewmates to disposable worktrees and holds decisions for the captain.

alternatives.why: Built-in background agents on cron, window or once schedules. Runs in the app.
A Mayor over 20 to 30 agents. One list line only. Not checked.

steps.why: Make a folder of markdown notes. A script asks a model for people and orgs, looks each up in an index file, and writes backlinks. Run it twice: the files must match.

exam.name: Collaborating within and across teams to manage data and models

steps.why: Label 30 pairs as same or different entity. Score merge precision and recall. When unsure, do not merge.
